create_image_generation: create an SGLDiffusionServerAPI client and generate an image from a text prompt with size and style options
edit_image_with_mask: edit an existing image using SGLDiffusionServerAPI with an input image and optional mask path
generate_video_from_prompt: generate a video from a text prompt using SGLDiffusionServerAPI with configurable size and duration
